description: This file implements the core logic of the ResourceManager plugin, including initialization, method registration, and handling of AV blocking, TTS resource reservation, and related functionalities for a media/resource management system within a larger framework.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.description: Main class implementing the resource management plugin, handling AV blocking, TTS reservation, and communication with other system components.

classes.name: JSONRPCDirectLink
classes.description: Helper class enabling direct JSONRPC calls through a dispatcher, facilitating synchronous method invocations with response handling.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the ResourceManager plugin, sets up security tokens, and registers methods.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin instance during shutdown.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently a placeholder.

methods.name: setAVBlockedWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to handle AV block/unblock requests via JSON parameters.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplicationsWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to retrieve list of applications currently blocked from AV functionalities.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to reserve TTS resources for a specific application.

methods.name: setAVBlocked
methods.description: Sets or clears AV block status for a given application identifier.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplications
methods.description: Retrieves list of currently blocked applications.

methods.name: reserveTTSResource
methods.description: Sends a request to reserve Text-to-Speech resources for a specified application.
